label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

Right, I’ve got a wee surprise planned for Gran before her birthday dinner and I’m absolutely buzzing about it!

Morag’s said I can have Hair by Morag to myself on Saturday 12 December from 1pm, after she closes at 12. So I’m going to do everyone’s hair for free before we head out for dinner. Seven heads to get through, so we’ll have a busy afternoon, but how nice will it be getting ready together?

I can do a cut and blow-dry for everyone, and Ava and Ruby can get wee braids and glitter spray if they fancy it. They’ll love that! I can do colours too, but I need to know what you want by **Friday 27 November** so I can get everything ordered from the wholesaler. If I don’t hear in time, it’ll just be a cut and blow-dry.

Gran said at Easter she’d “love to go silver properly” but wouldn’t pay salon prices, so I’d love to give her that as part of her surprise if she still fancies it. Mum, could you maybe find out what she’s thinking without giving the game away? I’ll need to have a proper look at her hair before I can say what’s possible.

Mum, would you also be able to get Gran to the salon for 1 without telling her why? You’re probably our best bet for getting her there without her getting suspicious!

Dinner’s booked for 8.30 at the Italian on Byres Road, table for nine including Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man, so we’ll have time to get ourselves ready and head over.

Bring a bottle of fizz too if you fancy it. Morag’s fine with it as long as we tidy up after ourselves. And Linda, at least this time we won’t have to worry about getting dye on your cooker and the dog 😂

Let me know what you all want done, especially any colours, by the 27th. Can’t wait! ❤️
